assurance_limit: This receipt proves the normative decision rules reject the adversarial cases. It is not a claim that every future provider adapter already contains native enforcement; governed adapters must pass conformance before use.

tests.input: Change modifies permission policy but author labels it MINOR_REVERSIBLE.
tests.rule: permission policy is automatic material trigger

tests.input: Otherwise minor reversible change has only author/implementer eligibility attestation.
tests.rule: author alone cannot establish Fast Path eligibility

tests.input: Side effect request has no authorization decision.
Authorization/grant expiry is earlier than execution time.
Existing grant was valid when issued but current revocation generation is newer.
tests.rule: revocation overrides grant and stale revocation generation invalidates decision

tests.input: Grant permits draft branch A but request targets main or another external target.
P4 operation is otherwise permitted but exact Owner Gate reference is missing or mismatched.
tests.rule: missing required Owner Gate has deny precedence

tests.input: Existing valid grant requests nonessential external write after Emergency Safe Mode/freeze generation advances.
P5 prohibited operation presents a grant and Owner Gate.
tests.rule: P5 prohibition has highest precedence and Owner Gate cannot override

tests.input: All other vNext criteria pass but no independent material architecture verdict exists for the exact review-stable head.
tests.rule: DOD-13 exact-head independent review is unconditional for this North Star candidate
